s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive painful skin lesions and ulcers with systemic symptoms and laboratory abnormalities
salient_findings: Progressive, painful blisters and ulcers of the groin
Enlargement of the tongue with difficulty with mastication
Numbness without weakness of the distal lower limbs
key_facts: 1-week history of progressive, painful blisters and ulcers of the groin
3-month history of tongue enlargement leading to difficulty with mastication
3-month history of numbness without weakness of the distal lower limbs
History of IgG λ-type multiple myeloma complicated by anemia and lytic lesions in the calvarium
Patient is taking folic acid and intramuscular cyanocobalamin supplements due to deficiencies
Circinate purpuric patches with erosions on the natal cleft, buttocks, inguinal creases, and vulva
Hemorrhagic flaccid bullae on the posterior perineum
Macroglossia, glossitis, and a hemorrhagic erosion on the hard palate
Purpuric macules present periorbitally, on the lips, inframammary folds, forearms, and thighs
Low serum zinc level
Subepidermal blister lined by fibrin and chronic inflammatory infiltrate with scattered short eosinophilic bands in the dermis
Apple-green birefringence on polarized light microscopy with Congo red staining
